name: Blake Radcliffe
source:
In his early 30s (but hates being reminded of it).

Cynical, grumpy, and short-tempered - but can be sweet sometimes.

Enjoys watching hospital documentaries, as he finds the blood and guts cathartic.

Has a huge fondness for musicals, particularly The Phantom of the Opera - and nurses an intense, seemingly irrational hatred for the Hollywood actor Gerard Butler.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43275]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
